title: How does bamboo grow so fast?
group: HOWN — How and Why in Nature
examples: Is bamboo a tree or a grass?
Why is bamboo the fastest growing plant?

explain.say: Some bamboo shoots can grow up to 91 centimetres in a single day, making bamboo one of the fastest-growing plants on Earth. And bamboo is actually a giant grass.

draw.text: How does bamboo grow so fast?

explain.say: A new shoot pokes out of the ground already as wide as it will ever be, with all its segments packed tightly inside, like a folded telescope. Its food comes from an underground stem network called a rhizome.

Instead of growing only at its tip like a tree, bamboo stretches in every segment at once. Many sections each growing a little add up to an enormous speed, mostly as cells fill with water and lengthen.
Within about two to three months the stem reaches full height and then never grows taller. Over the next few years it hardens into the strong, woody poles people use for building.

faq.q: Is bamboo a tree or a grass?
faq.a: Bamboo is a grass, related to wheat and lawn grass. It has a hollow, jointed stem like other grasses, but some kinds grow more than 30 metres tall.
asks: What kind of plant is bamboo?

faq.a: Some species can grow up to 91 centimetres in one day in ideal conditions, nearly 4 centimetres an hour. You could almost watch it move.
asks: How much does bamboo grow in a day?

faq.q: Why does bamboo grow in every segment?
faq.a: Each joint along the stem has its own growing zone, so all the segments lengthen at the same time. A tree grows taller only at the tips of its shoots.
asks: How does bamboo grow differently from a tree?

faq.q: Where does a bamboo shoot get its energy?
faq.a: From the rhizome, an underground stem linking many bamboo stems. The older leafy stems make sugar and store it there, ready to feed a burst of new shoots.

faq.q: Does bamboo keep growing taller every year?
faq.a: No. Each stem reaches full height in its first season and then stops, only getting harder and stronger. The clump spreads by sending up new stems.
asks: Do bamboo stems get taller over time?

facts: Guinness World Records lists certain bamboo species as growing up to 91 centimetres in a day.
A bamboo stem reaches its full height in a single growing season and does not grow taller afterwards.
Bamboo belongs to the grass family, Poaceae.

quiz.say: Why can bamboo grow so much faster than a tree?
quiz.show: Why can bamboo grow so much faster than a tree?

options.show: It has extra leaves at the top
options.say: It has extra leaves at the top

quiz.why: Each segment has its own growing zone, so the whole stem lengthens together, fed by the rhizome.

wrong.1: Bamboo grows day and night; that is not the reason for its speed.
wrong.2: Leaves do not make the stem stretch; the segments do.
